subject: maths
question: A trader buys 150 mobile phones at ₹8,000 each. He finds 10% of the phones defective and sells them at a 50% discount (on cost price). The rest are sold at a 10% profit. What is his overall profit or loss?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total phones = 150

Defective = 10% of 150 = 15, Normal = 135

Loss per defective = 50% of 8000 = 4000

Profit per normal = 10% of 8000 = 800

Total loss = 15 × 4000 = 60000, Total profit = 135 × 800 = 108000

Net profit = 108000 − 60000 = 48000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹48000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total phones = 150

Cost price per phone = ₹8000
